reviews.title: Perfect for people who want to have fun while staying active
reviews.text: I feel like I’ve finally found the perfect workout app for my needs. I’ve struggled with working out because I was never motivated to go to the gym or follow exercise videos on YouTube. But this app is friendly and great for people who want to be more active but lack motivation. The avatar is super cute and the energetic music motivates me to keep going. I love the count down and exercise introductions and I can definitely see myself continuing to use this app for my every day workouts!
